description: This source file implements API key authentication for a Django REST Framework application. It defines a custom authentication class 'APIKeyAuthentication' that authenticates requests based on a 'Token' header containing an organization API key. It also provides an OpenAPI extension class 'APIKeyAuthenticationScheme' to document this authentication method in API schemas. The functionality involves verifying API keys, retrieving associated organization and profile objects, setting request context, and integrating with OpenAPI schema generation.

classes.name: APIKeyAuthentication
classes.description: Custom Django REST Framework authentication class that authenticates API requests using an organization API key provided in the 'Token' header. It retrieves the organization and associated admin profile, sets context on the request, and handles authentication failure cases.

classes.name: APIKeyAuthenticationScheme
classes.description: OpenAPI schema extension class that provides schema details for the API key authentication method used in this API.

methods.name: authenticate(self, request)
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate a request by extracting the 'Token' header, validating the API key, and setting request context; returns the user profile if successful or raises an exception if not.

methods.name: get_security_definition(self, auto_schema)
methods.description: Provides OpenAPI security scheme details for API key authentication, specifying that the token is expected in the request header named 'Token'.
